title: DEFINE step 2 (0.29.0) PR A: persona tags on every gate check and two readiness levels (ADR-4126)
summary: Ship the compute layer for ADR-4126: CHECK_PERSONA / CHECK_QUESTION maps and persona + question on every stages[].checks[] entry; split skeleton:reqFields into skeleton:reqIntent + skeleton:reqShape and decisions:allAnswered into decisions:wellFormed + decisions:allAnswered; add the new D3 shapes:draftSettled check and the parseInterfaceDraft helper; fold levels (intentComplete, readyToBuild) and personas (productOwner, engineer) on the computeReadiness result; extend deriveNextAction with an optional persona filter; add formatVerdictLines shared by the CLI (PR B) and the Readiness tab (PR C). All additions are strictly additive; the 0.28.4 top-level shape is preserved and rcf define readiness default behaviour / exit codes are unchanged.
approach: One pass through src/query/gates.js adds the persona + question maps and plumbs them through makeCheck; the two splits are per-REQ / per-entry loops that evaluate every item independently so one failure never masks another; the shapes:draftSettled check parses the leading bracket marker on interface descriptions (whitespace tolerated). src/query/readiness.js folds levels + personas from stages[].checks[] after the eight stage functions run; deriveNextAction gains an optional persona argument; formatVerdictLines builds the two shared verdict strings. The CLI flags (--level, --persona) and the viewer tab land in PRs B and C of the same train and are out of scope here.
deliverables: src/query/gates.js: CHECK_PERSONA + CHECK_QUESTION + STAGE_FALLBACK_PERSONA maps; checkPersona / checkQuestion / parseInterfaceDraft helpers; split skeleton:reqIntent / skeleton:reqShape; new shapes:draftSettled; split decisions:wellFormed / decisions:allAnswered; makeCheck adds persona + question on every emitted check; D3 doc comment fix for TAD.dataArchitecture.coreEntities

src/query/readiness.js: levels (intentComplete, readyToBuild) and personas (productOwner, engineer) fold; deriveNextAction gains an optional persona argument; formatVerdictLines builds the two shared verdict strings
src/query/index.js: re-export the new helpers (CHECK_PERSONA / CHECK_QUESTION / STAGE_FALLBACK_PERSONA / parseInterfaceDraft / deriveLevels / derivePersonas / formatVerdictLines)
test/query/gates.test.js and test/query/readiness.test.js: new cases covering AC-17402-*, AC-17403-* and AC-17502-*
CHANGELOG [Unreleased] entry describing the additive compute changes
notes: PR B (CLI --level / --persona + text report) and PR C (Readiness viewer tab) are the remaining 0.29.0 step-2 PRs under REQ-175 / REQ-180 / REQ-181. No file under rcf/ is created or modified by any rcf define readiness invocation; the levels and personas folds are read-only derivations over stages[].checks[].
